newsitem.title: UK: Ldn Freight - Panamaxes dominate, BFI adds nine.
newsitem.headline: Ldn Freight - Panamaxes dominate, BFI adds nine.

text.p: Modern Panamaxes in the Atlantic continue to dominate the most active area of the freight market at the end of a week when the Baltic Freight Index added almost 50 points.

Demand from charterers for short period cover for modern Handies as well as Panamaxes is also a feature of the current scene. But brokers report weak conditions for older Handies everywhere, although some believe that the build-up in demand from grain charterers in the Atlantic should shortly benefit owners of such tonnage.
The early Caper market also remains weak, particularly for older vessels, but brokers report rising demand for March loading positions. The BFI added 9 points To 1415, up 48 points for the week.

Cargill booked the 1975-built Golden Cape 87,300 dwcc from Mississippi to Amsterdam for early March at a lumpsum equivalent of $11.00, compared to this charterer's fixture a week ago of Dimitrakis in this trade at $11.10 for prompt loading. Dreyfus were linked with Mega Hill 118,712 dwt for barley from the Continent to Saudi Arabia at about $18.00. A number of fixtures were completed from Argentina and Brazil without full details becoming available - Pioneer were said to have fixed a Panamax for a soyabean cargo from Paranagua to the Continent, Tradigrain were linked with Dynamic 52,510 dwt from Bahia Blanca to India, Anna 26,702 dwt was believed fixed by Cargill from the Plate to Buenaventura, and the prompt Sea Ranger II 29,300 dwt was covered on unknown terms for grain business also from the Plate.

New enquiries Friday included Cargill with 60/85,000 barley Hamburg and Dunkirk/Saudi Arabia for Feb 20/28, 35,000 heavy grain US Gulf/Barcelona option Brest Feb 24/28 and 21/22,750 heavy grain Up River/Cape Town for March 3/7, and Dreyfus with 40/56,000 soyabean pellets S Brazil/Rotterdam for Feb 20/28.

Halla were understood to have lifted subjects on the 1978-built Timios Stavros 64,730 dwt delivery prompt China for a Pacific Round at $9,000 daily, and Cobelfret or Klaveness were linked with Sapphire 68,000 dwt delivery Far East mid Feb for 4-6 or 5-7 months at $11,750 daily. In the Atlantic Transfield were rumoured to have booked Evlimeni 64,794 dwt delivery Continent for a trip via the Baltic to China with fertlizers at about $12,250 daily.

Alcinoe 34,000 dwt failed on subjects with Star for a trip from the Continent to New Zealand, as did Lilac Wave ,000 dwt Continent/Far East with Moller. E D and F Man fixed a 1976-built 40,000 dwt vessel delivery Spanish Med trip US Gulf at $4,750 daily. In the East World Umpire 47,000 dwt open prompt Pohang was fixed on private terms, Capetan Tassos 35,340 dwt was rumoured fixed at $7,400 daily for an Australian round, and Pacific Carriers booked a vessel of 24,000 dwt delivery Surabaya for a trip to S Korea at $5,200 daily.
